IF DB_ID('northwind') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE DATABASE northwind;
END



USE northwind;

--Crear Schema Gold
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = 'gold')
BEGIN
    EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA gold');
END



--Crear External Data Source
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'NorthwindDataLake')
BEGIN
    DROP EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE NorthwindDataLake;
END;

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE NorthwindDataLake
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://adslprodnorthwind.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/'
);

--Crear View para ORder details
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW gold.gold_order_details
AS
SELECT
    rows.OrderID,
    rows.ProductID,
    CAST(rows.UnitPrice AS FLOAT) AS UnitPrice,
    CAST(rows.Quantity AS INT) AS Quantity,
    CAST(rows.Discount AS FLOAT) AS Discount,
    rows.Total
FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'order_details/',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'NorthwindDataLake',
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS rows;


SELECT TOP 20 * FROM gold.gold_order_details;




--Customers
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW gold.gold_customers
AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'customers/',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'NorthwindDataLake',
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS rows;

SELECT TOP 20 * FROM gold.gold_customers;

-- 3.2 Employees
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW gold.gold_employees
AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'employees/',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'NorthwindDataLake',
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS rows;

SELECT TOP 20 * FROM gold.gold_employees;

-- 3.3 Orders
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW gold.gold_orders
AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'orders/',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'NorthwindDataLake',
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS rows;

SELECT TOP 20 * FROM gold.gold_orders;

-- 3.4 Products
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW gold.gold_products
AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'products/',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'NorthwindDataLake',
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS rows;

SELECT TOP 20 * FROM gold.gold_products;
